item.title: Prominent pundits and former politicians leave the GOP; is this the right move?
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by Daniel McAdams, executive director of the Ron Paul Institute, and Clint Russell, host of the Liberty Lockdown Podcast. The three discuss major moves from within the GOP as Tucker Carlson and Marjorie Taylor Greene say they no longer consider themselves Republican. Is this the next big rift in the MAGA movement, and will the America First movement, as well as the entire GOP, survive such open rebellion? Don’t miss it!

item.title: Is resistance futile: Local communities take the fight to high-tech data centers
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes looks at the growing and disturbing trend of high-tech data centers popping up across the nation. Record energy and water consumption, as well as noise and light pollution, and even health effects, are forcing local communities to take action to try and prevent their spread. But is it working? And will the government continue to fast-track these installations? And more importantly... what are the data centers going to be used for? AI? Computing? Or mass surveillance? Scottie is joined by Austin Siebert, founder of the Quantum Party of America, and Sarah Westfall, host of Business Game Changers.

item.title: The passing of Lindsey Graham: A legacy of belligerence and warmongering
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes talks about the recent passing of a notorious hawk, US Senator Lindsey Graham. His legacy is one of constant instigating and pushing for war: in Ukraine, in Gaza, Iran, Syria, and more. Will the world be a safer place now, or will the neocon establishment just push along? Scottie is joined by Austin Steinbart of the Quantum Party of America and legal and media analyst Lionel.

item.title: Democrats win big in NYC on a socialist platform: is this the future of the party?
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes sits down with independent commentator Kaizen Asiedu and Jose Vega, independent candidate for New York’s 15th district. The three discuss whether or not the Democratic party is pushing too far to the left in embracing democratic socialists. Is Zohran Mamdani setting a trend that will turn the Democrats into a radical left wing party? Tune in and catch the conversation.

item.title: Trump’s Endorsement: The golden seal that holds the key to victory
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes discusses the power of the Trump Endorsement. US President Donald Trump is now 8-0 in his endorsements of GOP candidates and is fresh off a major victory of Thomas Massie in Kentucky’s 4th District. So, is Trump the undisputed king of the GOP, and will an opposition America First movement ever take off? Joining Scottie for this discussion are Garland Nixon, political and geopolitical analyst, and Scott Stantis, cartoonist for the Chicago Tribune.

item.title: The Supreme Court’s summer of consequences: Rulings that will determine the future of the US
item.description: On this episode of America First , Scottie Nell Hughes is joined by conservative commentators Steve Malzberg and Melik Abdul. The three discuss one of the most consequential seasons of rulings in the Supreme Court’s history. Will the court uphold President Trump’s agenda, or deal more blows to MAGA? Their decisions could decide the fate of the country. Don’t miss it!
